title: Slice restriction commutes with total derived inverse limit of strict towers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $U$ an object of $\mathcal C$. Put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ and $\mathcal A_U=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O|_U)$ on the slice site $\mathcal C/U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $j_U^*:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A_U$ be restriction and let $j_U^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}$ apply it levelwise to $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$, with levelwise exactness. Both restrictions induce termwise functors on unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $L_{\mathcal A}$ and $L_{\mathcal A_U}$ for total right derived inverse limit, computed by a K-injective resolution of strict towers followed by termwise inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$j_U^*L_{\mathcal A}(X)\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathcal A_U}(j_U^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}X)$$
for every $X\in D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A))$. It is the derived comparison induced by the underived restriction/limit comparison and commutes with each tower projection. In particular it identifies the derived limit of the multiplication-by-$a$ tower of any $H\in D(\mathcal A)$, restricted to $U$, with the derived limit of the multiplication-by-$a|_U$ tower of $H|_U$, for every global section $a$ of $\mathcal O$.

proof.text: Promote the given sectionwise commutative ring sheaf to CommRingCat without changing its underlying ring sheaf (the private proved helper slice_commRingSheaf). Apply the independent-universe localizedSystemExact and localizedSystemAdjunction declarations of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Whisker the adjunction by the strict tower index. Mathlib whiskeringRight_preservesLimitsOfShape and whiskeringRight_preservesColimitsOfShape lift both exactness assertions levelwise, using [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. The actual exact restrictions induce mapDerivedCategory as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tags 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero) and 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero-exact); componentwise lift of the adjunction to strict towers

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective] to the additive adjunction $E^{\operatorname{Tow}}\dashv j^{\operatorname{Tow}}$ of Step 1, whose left adjoint is exact. It follows that if $I$ is a K-injective complex of strict towers, then $j^{\operatorname{Tow}}I$ is K-injective as a complex of strict towers on $\mathcal C/U$. This is K-injectivity in the whole tower category, rather than just K-injectivity of each evaluated complex.

source.place: Tag 08BJ (lemma-adjoint-preserve-K-injectives), applied to the two abelian tower categories

proof.text: The actual restriction is a right adjoint by Step 1 and therefore preserves countable limits. Mathlib preservesLimitNatIso gives lim followed by restriction isomorphic to levelwise restriction followed by lim. Apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex to obtain the natural comparison c on complexes. The limit universal property identifies its components with the already fixed sliceStrictTowerLimitComparison: after composing with each projection, both degreewise maps equal the restriction of that projection by preservesLimitIso_hom_π and limit.post_π. The equality with every limit projection is limit.post_π. This uses the actual sectionwise functor [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Tag 04IX (definition-localize-ringed-site), rule j_U^*F(V/U)=F(V); sectionwise compatible-tuple calculation

proof.text: Obtain L, LU and their units from ringedStrictTowerHomotopyLimitOfUniverses of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] on the original and localized sites. On the full category of K-injective tower complexes let QI be inclusion followed by DerivedCategory.Q. Whiskering the original unit by restriction gives an invertible transformation α. Composing the exact-functor factorization isomorphism, the comparison c, the localized unit and the inverse tower factorization gives β. It is invertible because restriction preserves K-injectivity by Step 2 and both units are invertible there. Thus α inverse followed by β is an isomorphism after precomposition with QI.

source.place: Tags 0940 (section-derived-limits) and 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok), K-injective strict-tower computation on C and C/U

proof.text: The private proved helper slice_kinjective_localization shows QI is a localization at quasi-isomorphisms. Fullness follows from the Hom bijection of [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived] and the full homotopy quotient; essential surjectivity follows from the resolutions of Step 4. If two chain maps have equal derived images, the same Hom bijection makes them homotopic. Their standard cylinder remains K-injective, its projection is a quasi-isomorphism, and it realizes this homotopy. Mathlib isLocalization_of_essSurj_of_full_of_exists_cylinders applies. Fully faithful whiskering along this localization descends α inverse followed by β to the required natural isomorphism e. Its defining equation holds on K-injectives. For an arbitrary complex choose q into a K-injective resolution: naturality and cancellation of the invertible derived image of q extend that equation to every complex. Composing with the tower factorization gives exactly the required normalization.

source.place: Tag 070I (lemma-K-injective), Hom bijection and homotopy-equivalence comparison; applied to tower categories

proof.text: For a K-injective tower complex I both units are invertible by Step 4 and preservation from Step 2. Cancel the image of the original unit in the defining equation for e; then compose with the inverse localized unit. The remaining equality is DerivedCategory.Q applied to limit.post_π from Step 3, so the asserted nth projection identity follows for every n. The functors are the fixed restrictions [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian] supplies their levelwise interpretation. Consequently multiplication-by-a transitions restrict to multiplication by the restricted scalar, including a=0 and a=1.
